In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] launched a '''raid''' on the [[Sith Citadel (Ziost)|Sith Citadel]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], intending to capture the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Starbreaker 12]]''. He succeeded, bringing the ship to his [[Naga Sadow's Khar Delba citadel|citadel]] on [[Khar Delba]].
